Advanced ATC

Ispezione di manutenzione di livello C

A comprehensive periodic maintenance inspection performed at longer intervals than A- or B-Checks, involving in-depth systems checks, component replacements, and structural inspections as prescribed by regulatory maintenance programs (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA Part 43).

Quick answer: A comprehensive periodic maintenance inspection performed at longer intervals than A- or B-Checks, involving in-depth systems checks, component replacements, and structural inspections as prescribed by regulatory maintenance programs (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA Part 43).
